domain_rationale: Row primary key / autoincrement ID from dataset extraction. Must never be used in ML models.
Flow start timestamp (epoch). Direct temporal identifier; models can memorize recording windows rather than network behavior.
TCP/protocol flags as string representations ('e', 'e s', etc.). Behavioral indicator of flow connection state.
Numerical encoding of protocol flags.
Transport/network protocol name ('tcp', 'udp', 'icmp', 'arp').
Numerical protocol identifier (IANA protocol numbers).
Source IP address. In testbed captures, fixed IP addresses correspond to specific attacker/victim nodes. Fatal environmental leakage.
Source port number. Attacker tools often use fixed source ports or hex-encoded ICMP codes (0x0303), causing synthetic artifact learning.
Destination IP address. Identifies target victim servers in the testbed topology. Severe environment leakage.
Destination port (service targeted, e.g. 80, 53). Useful behavioral context but can cause service-specific overfitting.
Total packet count in network flow.
Total byte volume in network flow.
Transaction state string ('INT', 'FIN', 'CON', 'REQ', 'RST').
Numerical encoding of transaction state.
Flow completion timestamp (epoch). Direct temporal identifier.
Sequence counter within packet aggregation stream.
Flow duration in seconds.
